Marissa / team —

Proposed negotiation posture below (high level + clause snippets). I think we can land this without escalating but recommend one exec touch if they hold firm at $5M and multi-year revenues are material.

1) Indemnity / cap
- Counter to $5M with a market-aligned cap: propose $3,000,000 OR 2x fees paid in the prior 12 months, whichever is greater. Rationale: aligns to revenue while bounding exposure.
- Carve out for willful misconduct and gross negligence (these remain uncapped as standard).
- Require customer to mitigate damages and cooperate in defense; allow Redwood to control settlement.

Suggested clause snippet (sendable):
"Liability Cap: Except for liability arising from willful misconduct or gross negligence, each party’s aggregate liability to the other for all claims arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) $3,000,000 USD, or (b) an amount equal to two times (2x) the Fees paid by Customer to Redwood under this Agreement in the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to liability."

2) IP / custom models
- We will not assign model IP. Instead offer a limited, non-exclusive (or term-limited exclusive), sublicensable license to custom model weights trained solely on Parallax data for Parallax’s internal business purposes for a defined period. Include restrictions preventing resale and require notification before derivative model commercialization.

Suggested language (summary):
"Customer Data Models; License: To the extent Redwood creates model weights trained solely on Customer Data, Redwood hereby grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use such Customer Data Models for Customer’s internal business operations during the Term. Redwood retains all underlying model IP. Any broader rights (assignment or exclusive commercial rights) require a separate agreement and compensation."

3) Export controls / data residency
- Exhibit as drafted is acceptable for hosted and dedicated modes; for Private/on-prem deployments propose an explicit clause that Redwood will not transfer Customer Data outside agreed jurisdictions without prior written consent, and Redwood will comply with applicable export control laws.

4) Practical negotiation tactics
- Offer the $3M or 2x fees cap, emphasize where we stand on IP, and offer an audit right plus SOC2 report as mitigation. If they insist on $5M, ask for procurement concessions (longer committed term or higher minimum commitment).

If you want, I can produce a redline to Parallax_Counterproposals.docx and I recommend we include a short legal-to-legal call tomorrow.

—Aditya
